title: US Measles Returned With 2,289 Cases After Elimination
hook: A disease eliminated nationally returned with 2,289 US cases.
closing: Vaccination gaps can bring measles back into communities that believed it was gone.
question: Did you know it returned?

segments.say: US measles reached 2,289 cases. A disease once eliminated nationally is spreading again.
Unvaccinated people made up 93% of US measles cases. The comeback follows gaps in protection, not chance.
The Texas measles outbreak reached 702 cases. One vulnerable pocket drove a large share of national spread.
